integrity: Exact-rational exhaustive overlap enumeration, symbolic characteristic-polynomial identity, and a separate finite-size covariance identity checked by executable certificate; historical priority and independent verification are not certified.
scientific_limitations: Applies to continuous iid observations and four consecutive windows. Exact eigenvalues, but not an explicit nonzero eigenbasis or finite-sample approximation error. The general CLT, covariance construction, and rank restriction are prior work; earlier implicit algebraic spectral coverage remains possible.
title: Exact asymptotic spectrum of four-point ordinal frequencies
